subject: Outreach for a Statistician position in the USDA Forest Service

messages.subject: Outreach for a Statistician position in the USDA Forest Service
parts:
I'm conducting an outreach for a GS-1529-12 Mathematical Statistician at the Pacific Southwest Research Station of the USDA Forest Service.  The position will be in either Davis, CA or Riverside, CA (which will be determined at a later date).  This is a great job for an applied statistician.  You would provide statistical consulting to our scientists for a wide variety of fields:  wildlife biology, hydrology, sociology, entomology, forestry, and ecology (just to name a few).

 

The following link has a bit more information with a document to fill in and send back to me if you or someone you know is interested:

 

    https://fsoutreach.gdcii.com/?id=8E047EAF1C4644FB90CC76029348CDD5

 

(With all of the applied folks using unmarked, I thought this would be great place to advertise the position.)


Thanks,

 

Jim


--

Station Statistician
